info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Analysis Product Portfolio API
info.description: The Business Analysis Product Portfolio API provides insights into the product offerings available to businesses. This endpoint enables consumers to access comprehensive details about various products tailored for business needs. Typical users include business analysts and product managers seeking to evaluate or enhance their product strategies. By leveraging this API, organizations can make informed decisions regarding product development and alignment with market demands.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a comprehensive analysis of the product portfolio, providing insights into product performance, market trends, and strategic recommendations.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving product portfolio data through the business analysis endpoint. This body must conform to the specified schema to ensure proper processing of the request.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the product portfolio details.
